files.check.py:
import json, pathlib, re
o = pathlib.Path('output/skills/release-notes')
ok = False
try:
    s = (o / 'SKILL.md').read_text()
    side = (o / 'agents/openai.yaml').read_text()
    readme = pathlib.Path('output/README.md').read_text()
    ok = (re.search('^name: release-notes$', s, re.M) is not None
          and re.search('^disable-model-invocation: true$', s, re.M) is not None
          and 'allow_implicit_invocation: false' in side
          and 'skills/release-notes/SKILL.md' in readme)
except OSError:
    pass
print(json.dumps({'score': 1 if ok else 0}))

    d = json.loads(pathlib.Path('output/evals/autoimprove.json').read_text())

cases.request: Run $skillz improve skills/demo/SKILL.md. Write each changed file under output/ with its repository path. Write the report to output/report.md. Put every speculative item in one line that starts with 'Approval question:'.

files.skills/demo/SKILL.md:
---
name: demo
description: >-
  Count the open items in a task list. Use when the user asks to "count tasks", "count open items", "how many tasks", "tally the list", or "open item total". Do NOT use for editing tasks.
disable-model-invocation: true
---

# demo

1. Run `python3 scripts/count.py <file>` to count the open items in the task list file.
2. Report the count.

Make sure that you always remember to carefully report the count of open items to the user in a single short sentence that names the file and then stop without doing any other work on the file or the list.
files.skills/demo/scripts/count.py:
import sys
print(sum(line.startswith('- [ ]') for line in open(sys.argv[1])))
files.check.py:
import json, pathlib, re
o = pathlib.Path('output')
ok = False
try:
    s = (o / 'skills/demo/SKILL.md').read_text()
    side = (o / 'skills/demo/agents/openai.yaml').read_text()
    r = (o / 'report.md').read_text()
    body = s.split('---', 2)[2].replace(chr(10), ' ')
    longest = max(len(x.split()) for x in re.split('(?<=[.!?]) +', body))
    ok = (longest <= 25
          and 'allow_implicit_invocation: false' in side
          and 'scripts/count.py' in s
          and re.search('before: ~?[0-9]+ tok', r, re.I) is not None
          and re.search('after: ~?[0-9]+ tok', r, re.I) is not None
          and len(re.findall('^Approval question:', r, re.M)) == 1)
except (OSError, IndexError):
    pass
print(json.dumps({'score': 1 if ok else 0}))

cases.request: Run $skillz wedge skills/demo. Write the brief to output/brief.md. Write no other file.

files.skills/demo/SKILL.md:
---
name: demo
description: >-
  Summarize a task list. Use when the user asks to "summarize tasks", "review the task list", "who owns what", "task summary", or "open items by owner".
---

# demo

1. Count the open items: read the file and tally every line that starts with `- [ ]`.
2. Sort the tally by owner, then by item name.
3. Decide with the user which owner needs follow-up.
files.check.py:
import json, pathlib, re
mode = json.loads(pathlib.Path('check.json').read_text())['mode']
written = sorted(str(p.relative_to('output')) for p in pathlib.Path('output').rglob('*') if p.is_file())
fields = ['Inputs', 'Output', 'Ordering', 'Empty', 'Errors', 'Side effects', 'Caller line']
ok = False
try:
    brief = pathlib.Path('output/brief.md').read_text()
    parts = re.split('^### Candidate ', brief, flags=re.M)[1:]
    rows = re.findall('^[|] [0-9]+ [|].*$', brief, re.M)
    full = all('**' + f + '**' in p for p in parts for f in fields)
    if mode == 'candidates':
        ok = (len(parts) >= 1 and full and len(rows) == len(parts)
              and all(re.search('line [0-9]+|[(][0-9]+[)]|L[0-9]+', row) for row in rows)
              and re.search('^## skillz wedge: ', brief, re.M) is not None
              and 'Run /wedge with candidate' in brief)
    elif mode == 'clean':
        ok = not parts and 'No offload candidates' in brief
    else:
        ok = not parts and 'packages only skills' in brief
except OSError:
    pass
ok = ok and written == ['brief.md']
print(json.dumps({'score': 1 if ok else 0}))
